hotspots.title: Krakow Mass Shooting & Far-Right Suspect
hotspots.blurb: A mass shooting in central Kraków left six people dead and over a dozen injured, with police finding three additional bodies at the suspect's home. Polish authorities identified the gunman as holding extreme ultranationalist and far-right views, prompting President Karol Nawrocki to declare two days of national mourning and Jarosław Kaczyński to call off PiS political rallies.
hotspots.affect: The combination of mass casualties, explicit far-right extremist motives, and nationwide mourning created high-voltage shock and political paralysis in Poland.

hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Following severe midterm losses, Donald Trump initiated a major White House shakeup by naming hardliner Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff while publicly courting UFC CEO Dana White for Press Secretary. The moves have drawn intense fire from both Democrats and conservative critics, as figures like JD Vance recalibrate 2028 plans and GOP lawmakers express alarm over aggressive DOJ retribution threats against political opponents.
hotspots.affect: The fallout from the election defeat has unleashed intense anxiety, aggressive personnel reshuffling, and fears of unchecked MAGA authoritarianism.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats Drop Cabinet Demand
hotspots.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson announced that the party is waiving its requirement for formal cabinet seats, positioning itself to support a center-right coalition from outside government. The strategic shift has sparked fierce debate across Swedish politics, with opposition parties accusing Åkesson of tactical maneuvering while right-wing commentators frame it as a statesmanlike masterstroke.
hotspots.affect: Åkesson's strategic pivot reshapes government coalition dynamics and provokes intense posturing and polarized speculation across the political spectrum.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: In the wake of electoral setback, Flávio Bolsonaro continues to aggressively challenge Brazil's election integrity, publicly attacking STF Justice Nunes Marques and claiming Donald Trump views Brazil as an incomplete democracy. Meanwhile, federal police are investigating alleged foreign assistance in Flávio's movement across borders, as the Bolsonarista movement faces legal pressure and banking collapses.
hotspots.affect: Claims of stolen elections, attacks on judicial authorities, and international conspiracy probes generate sustained outrage and high-stakes grievance among Bolsonaristas.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella escalated their 2027 presidential positioning by launching severe attacks against Jean-Luc Mélenchon’s left-wing platform, labeling it a 'dismantling of France.' Concurrently, Bardella accused left-wing activists of a 'totalitarian temptation' for seeking to shut down conservative news channel CNews, as RN rallies draw large crowds across France.
hotspots.affect: High affective investment surrounds framing left-wing policy as an existential threat to French national identity alongside intense media censorship battles.
